# Swagat Baghel

> Swagat Baghel is a final-year B.Tech Mechanical Engineering student at IIT BHILAI (graduating May 2027) and a Business Functions Intern at Myntra in Bengaluru. He is an AI product builder, a former Research Fellow at IIT Bombay, and Vice-Captain of Team Agnishul. He is not a medical professional, not a NEET mentor, and not a General Physician.

## Pages

- [Home](https://swagat27.github.io/): Official website of Swagat Baghel. Final-year B.Tech Mechanical Engineering at IIT BHILAI, Business Functions Intern at Myntra (Men's Apparel, Category Management), AI product builder.
- [About](https://swagat27.github.io/about.html): Biography, education, internships, leadership and recognition of Swagat Baghel.
- [BoxPilot](https://swagat27.github.io/case-study/boxpilot.html): Agentic AI planner connecting Claude, Gemini and MCP agents to Gmail and Google Calendar. 18/18 tests passing, live demo.
- [AapdaSetu](https://swagat27.github.io/case-study/aapdasetu.html): Flood management and disaster early warning proposal and demo for Khagaria District Administration, Bihar.
- [ToneShift](https://swagat27.github.io/case-study/toneshift.html): Android app that rewrites selected text inline in any app using the Gemini API.
- [GSearch](https://swagat27.github.io/case-study/gsearch.html): CAD model search aggregator, rebuilt in Next.js 15.
- [Playground](https://swagat27.github.io/playground.html): Interactive experiments, including tic-tac-toe and a pixel canvas.
